description: QtMesh Cloud helps users inspect 3D asset quality from ChatGPT. Users can list their projects, review scan summaries, inspect findings and scan reports, check quality gate settings, update owner-scoped quality gates, and control whether a project's public report is visible.

defaultPrompt: List my 3D asset projects and summarize their latest quality scores, errors, and warnings.
Show the error and warning findings from my latest scan, grouped by rule.
Check whether my project passes its quality gate and explain any failing conditions.
